takeaways.intro: Goal prices from 13,206 matches and 2,377,080 team-minutes. What they say for each audience:

managers.text: Level after 75': a goal for is worth **1.51 EP**, a goal against costs 0.96. The upside is 1.58× the downside.
managers.basis: 95% CI 1.56–1.60× · all 6 leagues · prices outcomes, not tactics

managers.text: 1–0 up after 75': conceding costs **1.51 EP**, a second goal adds only 0.31.
managers.basis: ratio 95% CI 0.19–0.22 · values, not the effect of sitting deeper

coaches.text: The last 15 minutes deliver **1.64×** the expected points of the first 15: more goals, higher stakes.

clubs.text: Don't pay for 'clutch': only **17** of 1,090 players scored at clearly better-than-average times, fewer than chance (~27).
clubs.basis: 20+ goal involvements · bootstrap intervals · repeatability not tested
